result.title: TACO-Graph: Automated Construction of Text-Atributed Graphs
result.summary: Graph-structured representations of text data have become foundational across machine learning, yet it remains unclear how to systematically construct a graph from a given dataset for a target task. Choices about which entities become nodes, which relationships become edges, and what text each node contains can substantially affect downstream performance. In practice, finding optimal constructions often requires expert knowledge or manual trial and error. We introduce TACO-Graph, a decision tree framework for learning which graph construction choices are most effective for a given dataset and task. Specifically, we focus on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) constructed from multi-attribute tabular data. TACO-Graph enumerates valid TAG representations, scores each using fast proxy evaluation on small representative subsets, and trains an interpretable decision tree on those scores. Across five datasets spanning citation networks, product reviews, and bibliographic relationships, our decision trees predict construction quality on separately drawn evaluation samples with mean Spearman $ρ$ above $0.9$ for node classification and above $0.8$ for GraphRAG retrieval. Our trees systematically identify which constructions perform better across both GNN and GraphRAG tasks, and the full pipeline is released as an open-source library to support evaluation on new tasks and datasets at https://github.com/AmiriHayes/text_attributed_graphs. TACO-Graph provides a systematic and interpretable guide for determining how to convert tabular data to text-attributed graphs for downstream tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TACO-Graph：将多属性表格数据转为 text-attributed graph 时，枚举候选构图方案（节点实体、边关系、节点文本），用小规模代表性子集做快速代理评测打分，再训练可解释决策树预测构图质量，用于节点分类与 GraphRAG 检索。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「哪些实体成为节点、哪些关系成为边、节点承载何种文本」的选择问题与用廉价代理评测筛选候选表示，可能为 LVR 中视觉实体/关系如何写入内部状态、以及候选潜在表示的低成本比较提供评价思路，可供核查迁移价值。
